units.source_text: 薰中纳言久住于此，形同主人，随意呼唤侍女。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had stayed here so long that he behaved almost like the master of the house, freely calling the serving women as he pleased.

units.source_text: 许多侍女替他料理膳食。

en.t: Many of the serving women prepared and attended to his meals.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看了觉得可哀而亦复可笑。

en.t: Prince Niou saw this and found it both pitiful and rather amusing.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言面庞非常苍白而瘦削，常常茫然若失地耽入沉思。

en.t: Kaoru's face was very pale and thin, and he often sank into deep thought with a vacant, lost expression.

units.source_text: 匂亲王很可怜他，郑重地向他慰问。

en.t: Prince Niou felt great pity for him and offered him careful words of consolation.

units.source_text: 大女公子逝世情状，言之虽然无益，但薰中纳言很想向匂亲王诉说。

en.t: Although speaking of how the Elder Princess had died could serve no purpose, Kaoru very much wanted to tell Prince Niou about it.

units.source_text: 既而觉得诉说起来心甚颓丧。

en.t: But then he felt that telling the story would only leave his heart utterly cast down.

units.source_text: 又恐匂亲王笑他执迷不悟，因此对他很少说话。

en.t: He also feared that Prince Niou would laugh at him for clinging so stubbornly to his grief, and so he spoke very little to him.

units.source_text: 日子既久，面貌也变了相，却反而比前更加清秀了。

en.t: As the days passed, his appearance changed, yet he seemed even more refined and handsome than before.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想道：“此人倘是女的，我必然会动恋慕之心。”

en.t: Prince Niou thought, If this man were a woman, I would surely fall in love with him.

units.source_text: 这原是他的怪僻的邪念，但他因此而担心起来，

en.t: This was, of course, one of his strange and wayward thoughts, but because of it he began to feel uneasy.

units.source_text: 打算在不受他人讥议及怨恨的情况下叫二女公子移居到京都去。

en.t: He planned to have the Second Princess move to Kyoto in a way that would not invite criticism or resentment from others.

units.source_text: 二女公子对他如此无情，倘被父皇母后闻知，实甚不利，

en.t: If his father the emperor and his mother the empress learned that the Second Princess was treating him so coldly, it would be extremely unfavorable.

units.source_text: 因此他很担心，决定今天就返京都。

en.t: For that reason he was deeply worried and decided to return to Kyoto that very day.

units.source_text: 他对二女公子热诚地说尽了千言万语。

en.t: He poured out countless earnest words to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 二女公子也觉得冷淡使他难堪，想回答他几句话，然而终于不能舒怀。

en.t: The Second Princess also felt that her coldness was causing him pain and wanted to answer him with a few words, but in the end she could not open her heart.
